definitions.ingest: Fresh201 accepted measurement jobs / actual load window, at least the requested duration.
definitions.herd_dispatch: 50000 / (last queued_at - common scheduled_for), persisted statement timestamps.
definitions.herd_successful_drain: 50000 / (last finished_at - common scheduled_for), persisted statement timestamps.
definitions.soak_success: Sum executions_total result=succeeded counter delta / its scrape-aligned window inside load. Exact endpoints in each execution_counter.
definitions.soak_db_rates: Persisted dispatch/success transitions inside the load window / load-window seconds; can include late warmup finishes and exclude drain.
definitions.sql_start_p99: Exact measurement job cohort percentile of started_at - scheduled_for, includes drain starts.
definitions.prometheus_start_p99: Histogram estimate after summing replica buckets; load temporal window differs from cohort. Dashboard uses rolling rate windows.
definitions.cpu_percent: Docker sampled CPU; 100% is one logical CPU. Resource summaries filter sample timestamps to the reported measurement window.
